authoring.note: The concourse where the two rail systems meet and nobody is permitted to walk straight through. Mainland passengers come down from the up-line platforms, queue at the barrier, show a pass, and climb again to the island platforms on the far side. The crossing takes eleven minutes when nothing is wrong and forty when it is. Benches, a tea stand, and a departures board that lists the island services in a separate, smaller column. Everyone who does this daily has firm opinions about which barrier lane moves fastest.
